title: MATRIX_LR=0.08 at DEPTH=10
description: Increased MATRIX_LR (Muon LR for matrix params) from 0.04 to 0.08, keeping DEPTH=10 and everything else unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb 1.004728, slightly worse than the DEPTH=10/MATRIX_LR=0.04 baseline (1.002530). Doubling MATRIX_LR to 0.08 was too aggressive at this width -- combined with a2's round-0 result (0.06 beating 0.04 at the old DEPTH=8), this suggests the Muon LR optimum is somewhere between 0.04 and 0.08, likely near 0.05-0.06, not higher. Useful bracket point: it rules out 'more is better' for MATRIX_LR at DEPTH=10.
